headline: Design boards of the Home Assistant pages drawn from a running copy
summary: Build 118 adds a design canvas of fifteen boards. Each board shows one Home Assistant page at 1440 pixels and on a 390 pixel phone, in light and dark. The boards are drawn from the frontend of this repository while it runs against a core, so they show what the pages really look like.
summary_yue: 第 118 版加咗一塊設計畫布，有十五塊畫板。每塊板顯示一個 Home Assistant 頁面，分別喺 1440 像素同 390 像素嘅手機闊度，淺色同深色各一。畫板係由呢個儲存庫嘅前端，連住一個運行緊嘅核心畫出嚟嘅。

other.title: Adds a design canvas with fifteen boards of the Home Assistant pages, drawn from a running copy of the frontend.

no_feature_note: This version is design work only: it adds boards that show the pages, and nothing a person using the product would notice has changed.
